events.title: A caliphate centered on Damascus
events.summary: The Met dates the beginning of Umayyad rule to 661, with power centered in Syria.
events.note: A political transition, not a claim that every region shared one culture or experience.

methodology: Twenty-four selected events from UNESCO and the Metropolitan Museum of Art cover political changes, learning, cities, trade and architecture from 661 to 1648 CE. Century bands use editorial numeric bounds for filtering; exact years and construction ranges retain the institution’s precision. The map uses public-domain Natural Earth land shapes with no political borders. It is regional orientation, not a map of historical sovereignty. No Quran passage is used to prove a later historical date.
